assertions.assert: `bot.ability.embedding.input` `{id, role, items}` is embedded through the generate service's embeddings mode (`POST {base}/embeddings`, with its `model` and `dimensions`, `<param>`s defaulting to `embeddinggemma-2` and 256) and answered to its sender (`_event.origin`) `bot.ability.embedding.output` `{id, space: {model, dimensions}, role, vectors: [{values}]}`: the id and role echoed, one unit vector per item, in the items' order whatever the order of the reply's rows.
Requests that arrive while one is in flight are held and served in order, each answered once.

A request the embedder cannot serve is answered `bot.ability.embedding.failed` `{id, kind, message}`, and the next request is served: an error status is `embed_failed` (`The embedder failed (status).`), a reply that is not one vector per item `invalid_response` (`The embedder failed (malformed).`), and no answer within `timeout_ms` (10 s, a `<param>`) `timeout` (`The embedder did not answer within <s>s.`).
An input its schema refuses (no items, a part without text, no id) never arrives: the send raises `error.execution` in the sender, and the next request is served.
